title: the candidate worktree inherits the same environment as the attempt
proves: pins the regression fixed in ce675f9: the integration candidate worktree is verified separately from the attempt worktree, and only the attempt used to get node_modules linked in. A verification command that shells out to something under node_modules therefore passed in the attempt and failed in the candidate, and the failure read as the node's own defect rather than a missing install. Setup creates a repository-level node_modules directory (fixed content, no npm install) and the node's verification command checks, in whichever worktree it runs, that a file under node_modules is reachable; with the fix this passes identically in both worktrees on the first attempt.

contract.goal: prove the integration candidate worktree inherits the attempt's environment
